title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
content: OpenAI will implement support for a shared robots.txt signal. This mechanism enables website operators to communicate their preferences regarding the use of their content for AI training. title: 外媒曝苹果曾用多种强势手段压低闪存采购价格
content: Apple previously used aggressive tactics to lower flash memory costs, including mandatory financial audits, ambiguous order commitments, and psychological pressure. It demanded top-tier pricing, audited supplier accounts, and initiated arbitration against Micron for inconsistent pricing. During price drops, Apple refused chips and employed extreme negotiation strategies, such as midnight sessions without food. Recently, rising memory prices have weakened Apple's bargaining power. Suppliers like Micron now criticize Apple's tactics for causing long-term industry capacity shortages, noting past periods of negative margins due to such behavior. Tensions remain high, especially with Micron's CEO having previously faced threats from Apple executives.
